items.prompt: A solver reports5%YTMfor a real bond. What would you verify before interpreting it?
items.modelAnswer: Schedule/face/currency, clean/full/accrual and settlement date, day count/compounding, credit/call/payment assumptions, bracket/location tolerance/status, fees/taxes/reinvestment and actual quote source. A numerical root is not a realized-return guarantee.

criteria.text: Separates solver success from model/payment assumptions.
Avoids treating YTMas a guaranteed return.
